name: delaunay
comment: Sig: T = delaunay(x, y). Brute-force empty-circumcircle triangulation of a generic 5-point set (no 4 cocircular). Row order + per-row vertex rotation are algorithm-specific and need NOT match MATLAB, so the fingerprint is order-invariant only: nT = number of triangles (= 2n-2-h, matches MATLAB for points in general position) and A = total triangle area (must equal the convex-hull area, tol 1e-12). Lifted to public C++ API numkit::builtin::delaunay (was adapter-only) 2026-06. NOTE on degeneracy: for cocircular sets (e.g. a square) the brute force keeps all C(4,3) triangles whereas MATLAB picks one diagonal — that case is intentionally excluded from this spec.
